title: Yellow Pillowy Australian Lentils Curry
description: A one-pot Australian dish featuring umami flavors, pillowy texture, and pickles, made with Jain-friendly ingredients. This curry is a delicious and hearty meal option.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add curry powder and turmeric and cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, pickles, and salt, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in coconut cream and continue to simmer for 5 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to mantecare-emulsify the curry to a pillowy texture.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
